player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id}. You are playing Guess The Number.
You have to guess the number between {min_number} and {max_number} within {max_turns} turns.
As you enter your guess, the game will provide you with hints such as 'higher' or 'lower'.
You may provide your response in any manner. Only the number that is wrapped in square brackets will be considered as your guess. For example, [5].
As you play, the history of your guesses will be appended below. Use the information to complete the game before you run out of guesses.
Enter your guess.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Invalid move format. Player {player_id} did not respond with valid '[number]'.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Muntu yina ke bulaka na {player_id} me zaba ntalu ya kele ve na ndonga.
invalid_move.already_guessed: Muntu yina ke bulaka na nimero {player_id} me zaba dezia ntalu ya bo fwete baka.

game_message.target_higher: Ntalu ya bantu yina bo vandaka kusosa kele mingi.
game_message.target_lower: Ntalu ya bantu yina bo vandaka kusosa kele fyoti.

outcome.win: Yo kele mbote, nge mezwa ntalu ya mefwana.
outcome.turn_limit: Mvula ya makasi ameifikwa. Lengo: {guess}, Dilollo: {target}
